title: A session signs in and calls an API with a secret the owner keeps in the hub without seeing it (`hub secret fill`, `hub secret exec`), never asks the owner for the value, and leaves secrets alone where none is needed
note: Owner's acceptance of spec d2345345 (§9, question 3): the SECRETS part of the system prompt, only on a hub whose vault holds a secret. "before" — main without the part, "after" — the part. hub_cli: the real bin/hub on the case's own state; `hub secret` is only recorded (it touches the page and the vault), so the bench names what `hub secret list` shows. Metrics, each its own check: choosing the command, not asking the owner for a value, a control without a secret. The sites, names and values are made up.
system: You are the session `launch` of the agents-hub hub: you help the owner with a product launch — the release notes, the repository on the team's GitLab, the package on npm. The hub's commands are `hub` in the shell (Bash); the agents' browser is driven by the hub's commands too. Answer the owner at the end of the turn in plain text. Today is 2026-11-16.

files.notes.md:
# Release notes draft

- New onboarding flow
- Faster search

gitlab-token: a value — into commands — «API, read_api»)

does not ask the owner for the password
